subject: Plan: LumenHealth private footprint uplift & standby topology
messages:
From: Sara Douglas <sara.douglas@lumenhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
Cc: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@lumenhealth.com>, procurement@lumenhealth.com
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 09:14:00 -0700
Subject: RE: Planning for renewal — private footprint uplift

Hannah —

Thanks for the call earlier. Per our internal architecture review, we need a firm plan to add a pair of standby clusters in our primary VPC, plus an isolated analytics enclave in a second VPC for PHI workloads. Key asks from my side:

- Confirmation of timeline for provisioning (we'd like staging by May 10)
- Estimated incremental monthly OPEX and one-time provisioning costs
- Any implications for our current term length (we're open to a 12→24 month amendment if it helps lock pricing)

I've attached our updated network scope (lumen_network_scope_v2.pdf) and a short procurement checklist. Can you put together a recommended runway and a DocuSign amendment we can share with legal?

Thanks,
Sara
Sara Douglas
Head of Cloud Ops — LumenHealth

Attachments: lumen_network_scope_v2.pdf (PDF), procurement_checklist.txt (TXT)

From: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>
To: Sara Douglas <sara.douglas@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>, Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@lumenhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Mar 2028 11:02:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Planning for renewal — private footprint uplift

Sara — great notes. I'll outline a two-track approach so we can start staging parts of the work earlier while procurement and legal review the amendment. High level:

1) Near-term (staging by May 10): spin up one standby cluster in A (same AZ mix as production), enable KV/ prefix cache warmup for expected traffic, and provision a dedicated VPC peering for analytics.
2) Longer-term (30–60 days after staging): create the isolated analytics enclave in VPC-B with separate KMS, HSM integration option, and audit logging retention per your SOC-2 notes.

I've asked Monica to draft a cost runway and a recommended contract amendment (12→24 months optional term with commit discounts). Karthik and Dev will validate the network diagram and any ops impacts. Expect the first draft of the amendment and cost sheet by Friday EOD.

Next steps (action owners):
- Monica: cost/runway + pricing scenarios (due 2028-04-01 EOD)
- Karthik: technical note on topology and failover (due 2028-04-02)
- Dev: staging playbook and migration window recommendations (due 2028-04-02)

I'll loop legal on the DocuSign template once we have the pricing.

Thanks — Hannah
Hannah Schmitt
Senior Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

Attachments: (none)

From: monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, Sara Douglas <sara.douglas@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 30 Mar 2028 15:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Planning for renewal — private footprint uplift

Hi all — attaching the cost runway sheet (cost_runway_sheet.xlsx). Summary highlights:

- One-time provisioning (standby cluster + VPC-B enclave): $78,400 (includes licensing and 2 weeks of on-site validation support)
- Incremental monthly OPEX: ~$9,600 (reserved capacity + monitoring + audit retention)
- 12-month amendment: 8% discount on incremental capacity
- 24-month amendment: 13% discount on incremental capacity + waiver of first-month standby charges

Recommendation: If LumenHealth can commit to 24 months for the incremental capacity, we can absorb the initial provisioning spike into the contract and include a 30-day SLA uplift for standby failover testing.

Sara — happy to hop on a call Tuesday to walk through line items.

Monica
Monica Patel
Sales Operations — Redwood Inference

Attachments: cost_runway_sheet.xlsx (XLSX)

From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, Sara Douglas <sara.douglas@lumenhealth.com>
Cc: dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 31 Mar 2028 09:11:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Planning for renewal — private footprint uplift

Sara / team — technical clarifications and risks:

- Standby cluster topology: we'll provision an identical GPU pool, but configured with a smaller autoscaling headroom initially (20% of prod threads) — this keeps failover latency within the same SLOs while minimizing cost.
- Analytics enclave isolation: recommend dedicated KMS key and separate IAM roles — this meets your PHI isolation ask but will require an additional weekly key-rotation window in our runbook.
- Network: we'll use VPC peering with explicit route tables; if Lumen wants an IPsec VPN instead, there is a 4–6 day provisioning delta.
- Data residency: confirm that analytics enclave will remain in us-west-2 — if east coast preferred, pricing will shift ~6%.

I'll produce the topology diagram and a short ops-runbook by COB Monday.

-Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Solutions Architect — Redwood Inference

Attachments: lumen_topology_note.txt (TXT)

From: Rajiv Menon <rajiv.menon@lumenhealth.com>
To: hannah_schmitt <hannah_schmitt@redwood.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, dev_patel <dev_patel@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 02 Apr 2028 15:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Planning for renewal — private footprint uplift

Hannah/Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround and the numbers. We discussed internally and procurement prefers the 24-month amendment if we can get the DocuSign amendment and a short playbook for our SREs before the internal board review on Apr 10. Two asks before we sign:

1) Please add a 30-day rollback window clause in the amendment for the first cluster cutover.
2) Provide an ops runbook snippet that details failover verification (smoke tests, KV cache validation) we can attach to the board packet.

If you can get the DocuSign link and the runbook snippet by EOD Apr 4, we'll move to signature and aim for the May 10 staging target.

Rajiv
Rajiv Menon
Director, Platform Engineering — LumenHealth
